Q: GitHub Actions iOS build fails with “Exit status 65” – works locally with Xcode 16.1 A:

The issue is between your local Xcode (26.1) and what the workflow forces in CI (xcode-version: '16.1' on macos-14, per your own commented-out note). That's a huge SDK gap, and it's a common cause of exit 65 archive failures when your project needs anything from a newer SDK.

Try moving the runner to macos-15 (or macos-latest) and setting xcode-version to whatever's closest to 26.1 that image ships with - GitHub publishes the exact Xcode versions per macOS runner image in their runner-images repo, might be worth looking there first so you're not guessing. If the newer image doesn't have match-compatible versions of your dependencies yet, that's usually the next thing.

Q: How to clear/reset variable in PowerApps A:

You can follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to the Main Screen with the variable reset: Before navigating to the Main Screen, ensure the variable is reset to its default value or to an empty string.

    Navigate(MainScreen, ScreenTransition.Fade, { YourVariable: "" })

    Replace MainScreen with the name of the screen where your form is located, and YourVariable with the name of your variable.

  2. Reset the variable on Main Screen visibility: In the Main Screen's OnVisible property, reset the variable to its default value or to an empty string.

    UpdateContext({ YourVariable: "" })

Replace YourVariable with the name of your variable.

With these steps in place, whenever you navigate to the Main Screen with the form, the variable will be reset to its default value, ensuring that it doesn't retain the old value from previous submissions.

Q: unable to load your default controller on Codeigniter A:

According to codegniter manual managing multi application

in your index.php file change

$application_folder = 'application';

to 

$application_folder = 'application/home';

and make sure the controller file name starts with capital letter

controllers->Home.php

and keep Routes.php configurations

$route['default_controller'] = "home";
